notes.title: Continue Last Game
notes.content:
You can now continue your last game with the new "Continue Last Game" option, allowing you to jump right back into the action without losing your progress after quitting the game. This feature was requested a lot. A new button also "Restart" for faster restart (same deck and same difficulty but different seed of course). Prisms with Ethereal Aura now have a chance to appear in the shop or choice scenes, but it's very rare... Item "Ink" change to "Lava for clarity. More new feature will come in the future, with a new system to sort dice, and a potion to add a ghost die too !

notes.title: Steam Achievement
notes.content:
Steam Achievements Are Here!

Each achievement has been carefully designed to encourage players to explore the unique mechanics of Roll Five and to highlight their progress throughout the game.

Additionally, a complete rework of prism unlocking has been implemented. No more repetitive actions like "do Fortuna 66 times." Prism unlocks are now tied to Steam achievements. For every Steam achievement you complete, a corresponding prism will be unlocked.

This change allows player to focus on the core content of Roll Five: collecting prisms and building decks. I hope this update will be both satisfying and fun for you.

Now, I can return to balancing the game and working on the next update, which will allow you to add dice to your deck!

 Adding 75 new unlock type for Prisms linked to  steam achievements
 Adding Legendary Prism reward when you level up a figure level 10
 Adding legendary prism for Fortuna
 Adding legendary prism for Four of a Kind
 Adding legendary prism for Straight
 Adding legendary prism for Flush
 Adding legendary prism for Full House
 Adding legendary prism for Three of a Kind
 Adding legendary prism for Double Pair
 Adding legendary prism for Pair
 Adding legendary prism for High Dice
 Adding Prism Belt

 Upgrade Plate Fish bonus +3 Mult for +1 Mult
 Prism Bacteria only trigger on fight
 Adding Main / Secondary icons and text for figure list to inform player
 Add option to reset save BUT keep deck progress
 Shorter message for secondary hand that reach exp cap
 Fix prism Quarter correctly aply a minimum of 1MM

notes.content:

Added an option to "Always show secret figure".
Added icons for On/Off parameters in options and a wider right panel.
Full keyboard support.
New icons and tooltips for relics that allow prisms/relics/consumables to appear multiple times.

notes.content:

Implemented true endless health for monsters, fixing endgame crashes.
Extrapolated experience level curve to prevent crashes.
Resolved infinite loop issue when looting epic prisms.
Fixed text display issues in tooltips.
Fixing issue for steam cloud for Demo

Balancing:
First boss have less health for difficulty 0 and 1
Rune "Athena": Now changes 1 face to Amethyst instead of 2.
Relic "One More Choice": Tooltip updated to "+1 additional choice after Battle Won."
Relic difficulty: Tooltip updated to "Enemy -10% Health, Enemy Elite -10% Health."
Added gameplay tips for relics with effects like "Extreme," "First," and "Initial."
Prism "Anvil": Tooltip updated for better explanation (e.g., attack contains 2 Threes).
Prism "Agonie": Changed rarity from common to rare.

Gameplay Improvements:
Localization added for relics.
Keyboard shortcut introduced to disable tutorials.
Collection now displays only unlocked prisms.
Added detailed luck tooltips.

Art and Visuals:
Prices now appear green when modified by relics or prisms.
Added missing keyboard input icons.

Thanks you for your feedback.

notes.title: Demo 8 preview : Gamepad and Steamdeck support
notes.content:
Gamepad and SteamDeck support :

After a month of hard work, Roll Five will finally be playable with a GamePad and on SteamDeck! Since the beginning of the project, we had planned to be compatible with these devices, but the support was only finalized recently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004874/d90291bbadd586ef9c7107f3d6002e9ee5773455.png

The game doesn't yet have the official support badge for SteamDeck, but we are making every effort to meet all the basic criteria ahead of validation.

This isn't the only major change in the upcoming version 8 of the demo. There are many other things coming, such as a redesign of the icons, new prisms, and the number of relics has nearly doubled...

See you in september for demo version 8 !

notes.title: Demo 3 : New prism art, new content, and new features !
notes.content:
New Features:
* 24 New Prisms
* New artwork for prisms!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004874/f92f352244521d8843cd35bbddda79b521f71faa.gif
* Prism art themes are based on consumables, figures, retrigger, economy, and other types.
* Prism economy have a new aspect: "Piece".
* Prisms that retrigger dice now have a new aspect: "Trianglehedron".
* Prisms for dice figure bonuses now have a new aspect: "Cube".
* Prism consumables now have a new aspect: "Losange".
* Other prisms now have a new aspect: "Dodecahedron".
* New prism colors indicate rarity.
* Added localization for Chinese (Simplified), German, Japanese, Portuguese, and Spanish.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004874/6222ec215fa1f22f62021b60438ee4c258d80075.png
* Added a limit to the number of consumables a player can hold.
* Added juice effects when a prism is bought or chosen.
* Added a dialogue scene after defeating a boss in Story mode.
* Added Retrigger prisms.
* Added a preview of the current difficulty reached for each deck.
* Added a preview to the boss score bar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004874/69dd681be880cd5c9253770a292eda9189d3b03c.gif

New Content:
* Added relics: +1 Consumable slot, -1 Consumable slot, -1 Prism slot.
* Prism: Increase MultiplicativeMult when a prism is destroyed.
* Prism: Add MultiplicativeMult when the highest prism is destroyed.
* Prism: Destroy the highest prism and add its sell value to Mult.
* Prism: Add MultiplicativeMult when enhanced dice score and remove it.
* Prism: Create a rune when gold is low.
* Prism: Create a prism when entering a fight.
* Prism: Create a rune when entering a fight.
* Prism: Enhance each face when the condition is met.
* Prism: Create a rune if a figure is played.
* Prism: Add a boost figure if the correct condition is played.
* Prism: Give MultiplicativeMult if enough dice are enhanced.
* Prism: Incremental when a rune is used.
* Prism: Incremental when a boost figure is used.
* Prism: Black Jack.
* Prism: Score for each dice in hand when scoring.
* Prism: Shop discount.
* Prism: Mult if no repeat value in scoring.
* Prism: Give gold if the figure is different from the last figure.
* Prism: Mult for each relic you own.
* Prism: MultiplicativeMult if all DiceCharace are scoring.
* Prism: Increase MultiplicativeMult when entering a fight. Reset when entering a shop.
* Prism: Bonus if the player has more than two most played figures.
* Prism: Destroy if a black dice is played, otherwise give a multiplier.
* Prism: Add prism spheres; decrease each hand upgraded.

Bug Fixes:
* Fixed font issues for Chinese and Japanese.
* Fixed a bug where prisms would create rune/prism events when not bought. Wrapped on shop title.
* Fixed a bug where the "last consumable used" was persistent between games.
* Fixed a bug where scoring other dice would cause them to reroll for free.
* Fixed a bug where using the "Wine" consumable would cause the score target to drop below the current score, resulting in a win.
* Fixed a bug in the choice scene where tooltips and relics didn't get removed after making a choice.
* Improved prism color aspects and colors based on rarity.
* Fixed prism outlines.
* Fixed missing scripts on prisms.
* Fixed raycast bugs for prism selection
* Other localizations error
